title: Repairing Garments
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Practise on a cloth sample with a contrasting thread first, then on a real gaping seam. Count needles in and out.

skills.key_step: The child identifies running stitch (small, even stitches with equal gaps) and back stitch (stitches that meet end to end with no gaps, like a machine line) and says back stitch is stronger.
steps: Gaps: running stitch. No gaps: back stitch.

board.do: Draw a line of stitches with gaps and a line with none.
Point at the line with no gaps.

misconceptions.ask: Which stitch goes back to meet the last stitch, leaving no gap?
misconceptions.repair: Have the child sew a short line of each on a scrap of cloth and name them from the pattern.
Pull two seams, one in each stitch, and see which gives way.

misconceptions.ask: Which stitch leaves gaps between stitches on the front?
misconceptions.repair: Look at the front of both stitches on a scrap and count the gaps.

listen_for: They are the same and both are removed
misconceptions.ask: How is running stitch different from tacking?
misconceptions.repair: Lay a tacking sample beside a running stitch sample and measure the stitches.

checks.question: Which stitch has no gaps between stitches?
Which stitch is stronger for a seam?

skills.key_step: The child says how to repair a gaping seam: turn inside out, pin or tack the edges, start a little before the gap and end a little after it, back stitch along the old line, secure the thread, press.
representations: a garment with a gaping seam
steps: Start before the gap; back stitch along the old line.
End after the gap; secure; press.

board.do: Draw a seam with a gap in the middle.
Wait for "a little before the gap".
Mark the start and end beyond the gap.

misconceptions.ask: Which stitch repairs a gaping seam?
misconceptions.repair: Repair two seams, one in each stitch, and pull them.

misconceptions.ask: Where should the repair of a gaping seam start?
misconceptions.repair: Pull a seam that started at the gap and one that started before it.

misconceptions.ask: How tight should the thread be pulled?
misconceptions.repair: Look at a puckered seam and a flat seam side by side.

listen_for: The right side, where it shows
misconceptions.ask: Which side of the garment is a seam repaired from?
misconceptions.repair: Turn a shirt inside out and show the old seam line to follow.

checks.question: Why start stitching a little before the gap?
checks.answer: to join into the strong old stitches

checks.question: Which stitch is used to repair a gaping seam?
